name: Cache
description: Tells you when the prompt cache did not engage. The plugin monitors each provider request and its response. It looks for a request with cache marks and a response that did not read the cache. Then it sends one diagnostic with the source `cache.anomaly`. It sends one diagnostic for each type of cache error, and adds no text to the system prompt. The limits are in the `README.md` file, with the `target.didSwitch` event.
